title: Evaluating and Modeling Attribution for Cross-Lingual Question Answering
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper evaluates the attribution of answers in a cross-lingual question-answering setting, which does not involve faith or religion.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are related to the lack of attribution in cross-lingual QA systems and the effectiveness of NLI and LLM models for detecting attribution, with no analysis related to religion.
